pages.text: Activate every $(item)waystone$() you pass. From any waystone you can travel to any other you know.$(br2)A trip costs a little experience: 1 point per 100 blocks, at most 27 points, a flat 27 to another dimension. Warp plates, scrolls and global waystones are free.

The $(item)Warp Stone$() is your way home: hold it to travel to any waystone you know, from anywhere, for free. It never wears out, but it needs 5 minutes to recover after each use.$(br2)The quest $(item)A Stone of Your Own$() gives you one.
